about: How many lines a change of a file from `before` (null for a new file) to `after` added and removed: what the Thread's "Changed files" counts (counts(lineDiff()) in apps/agents/pane/src/entries/parts/diff.ts) and what a Thread's card says of its last turn (counted() in apps/agents/engine/src/changes.rs). Both read these cases, so the card and the Thread say the same. `many` is one case too long to write out: `lines` lines `line 0`, `line 1` and on before, and after, every odd one `changed 1`, `changed 3` and on instead.
